title: Quantum Information Science
summary: Quantum Information Science (QIS) is an interdisciplinary field merging quantum mechanics and information theory to revolutionize computing, encryption, and data processing. Leveraging quantum phenomena like superposition and entanglement, QIS enables breakthroughs in quantum computing, cryptography, and sensing. This article explores its history, core principles, applications, challenges, and future potential.
